title: WHO SMART Trust — GDHCN Source Documents Catalogue
sizeBasis: Measured 2026-11-01 from the one materialized document: the GDHCN Administrative and Operational Framework 1.2. Since bean folio-assistant-djj5 (2026-11-03) the catalogue also holds the 27 works the IG cites that are not ingested, as `referenced` items with no bytes held; `totalFilesUpstream` and `totalBytesUpstream` still count only the one materialized document.

sourceLoss.container: LOST WITH THE SOURCE. A container node holds only a title and upstream URL.
sourceLoss.referencedItem: METADATA SURVIVES, BYTES DO NOT. A referenced item keeps its node and its folio-dublin-core/v1 record; a cited work's capture is recorded in `uploads/<slug>/intake.json`.
sourceLoss.materializedItem: THE ARCHIVAL COPY SURVIVES. A materialized item's bytes are held in this repository with a recorded sha256 verified by `check:materialized-fixity`, alongside its qualified Dublin Core (`folio-dublin-core/v1`) record.
